newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil falls at close ahead of PORLA.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil falls at close ahead of PORLA.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - The market closed lower on technical selling and liquidation ahead of PORLA's May crop data on Monday at 0430 GMT. A lower cash market also affected sentiment. Trading was cautious with more selling seen after August broke 1,180 support. Ivan Wong's report has no impact on the market.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Also eased on lower futures market and lack of buyers. Some interest was seen in products.
Malaysia's palm oil output in May was estimated to have risen by 6.4 percent to 780,000 tonnes over April, crop forecaster Ivan Wong said on Friday.
Wong put palm oil stocks at the end of May at 740,000 tonnes, compared with his earlier estimates of 745,000 tonnes and PORLA's 697,714 tonnes at end-April.
Wong maintained his earlier estimates of palm oil exports in May at 635,000 tonnes against 570,067 tonnes in April.
Selling emerged in the afternoon session as players liquidated due to the poor performance in the cash market.

"There was a lack of buyers in the cash market and this prompted selling which pulled down futures contracts," a trader said. "August futures fell below the support level of 1,180 ringgit and became nervous and started throwing their positions," a trader said.
At the close, August futures closed nine ringgit lower at 1,177 ringgit ($468.36) a tonne. Turnover was 1,567 lots
Physicals June (south) saw offers at 1,220 ringgit against bids at 1,212.50 and June (central) at 1,205 versus 1,200.
July (south) saw offers at 1,220 after bids of 1,212.50 and July (central) saw offers at 1,205 against bids of 1,200.
In refined products, July RBD palm oil was offered at $510 and Aug/Sept at $505. July was traded at $510 and Aug/Sept at $510.
July RBD palm olein saw offers at $555 and Aug/Sept at $550. July was traded at $552.50 and $555.
July RBD palm stearin was offered at $382.50 and July palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $280.
